faq: Do I need a Framer account first?
Yes. You create a Framer account and the site lives in it, so you own everything. A paid Framer plan is needed to connect a custom domain, and Framer bills that to you directly.
Can I edit the site myself afterward?
Yes. Framer has a visual editor, and we set up text, images and CMS items so they are simple to change. Our training guide shows exactly how, with no code needed.
Do you write the copy and take the photos?
You send the words and images you have. We tidy the wording where it helps, and the optional copy add-on covers short page text if you need it.
Is Framer good for search visibility?
Framer sites load quickly and let you control titles, descriptions and headings, which helps. We set those up properly, but we cannot promise any search ranking.

desc:
A Framer website design and development project gives you a new site built around your brand, with pages, forms and content tools ready to launch. Ecom Swift LLC designs and builds your Framer site in your own Framer account, then hands it over with a launch checklist and an editing guide.

## What is a Framer site build?

A Framer site build is the design and construction of a complete website in Framer, from the first layout to the live custom domain. It covers page structure, visual style, responsive layouts, animation, forms, the CMS and search titles.

Because we work in your account, you own the project from the start. There is nothing to transfer at the end, and you can keep editing the site yourself.

## Why the brief matters more than the tool

Framer gives designers a lot of freedom, which is why a site build can go wrong in a different way from a template site. Without a clear brief, pages drift toward whatever looks impressive. Motion gets added because it can be, and the point of the site gets lost.

We begin with the questions that decide the design: who visits, what they need to decide, and what you want them to do. Those answers set the page structure, the order of sections and the tone. Visual polish then serves a purpose.

## How a well-built site helps your business

A site is often the first place a stranger judges you. A calm, clear design shows that the business is careful. Forms that work and pages that load quickly make it easy to get in touch. A CMS lets you add posts, projects or team members without calling a designer.

Search visibility starts at build time. Page titles, heading order, image sizes and clean structure are far cheaper to get right during construction than to repair later. A site made with these in mind gives you a sound base for everything you add.

## What a strong Framer site includes

- A layout planned around your audience and goal.
- Your logo, colors and fonts applied consistently.
- Pages for home, services or products, about and contact, as the package allows.
- Responsive layouts checked on phone, tablet and desktop.
- Restrained animation on scroll and hover.
- Working contact forms with a clear confirmation.
- CMS collections for a blog, projects or other lists you will update.
- Reusable components for repeated sections, so edits stay consistent.
- Search titles, descriptions and social sharing images.
- Custom domain connected, with analytics and form tracking in larger packages.

## How we work

We begin with a short brief covering your brand, audience and goal. We lay out the pages, share a private preview link and refine until it fits. Then we add the forms, CMS content, search titles and domain, and check everything on real devices.

Basic builds a small site or one-page site with your branding and a contact form. Standard covers a multi-page site with a CMS collection, scroll and hover animation, search titles, social images and a connected domain. Premium delivers a fully custom site with several CMS lists, custom components, analytics and form tracking, a recorded training walkthrough and a period of fixes.

At handover you receive a launch checklist and an editing guide. If you want writing support, page copywriting is available as an add-on.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Share your logo, colors and any brand rules.
- List the pages you need and what each should do.
- Provide real photos and text where you can.
- Collect examples of sites you admire.
- Name one person who gives final approval.

**Avoid:**
- Adding pages that have no clear purpose.
- Using heavy animation on every section.
- Starting before you know what the main action is.
- Using low-quality photos that undermine the design.
- Launching without testing forms on a phone.

## Who this is for

This service suits a new business that needs its first proper website, a freelancer or studio building a portfolio and an established company moving from an outdated site. It also fits teams that want a design-led site they can edit themselves.

Framer works well for marketing sites and portfolios. If you need a large online store, tell us and we will point you to a better fit.

## What we need from you

Send a short brief, your logo and brand files, any text and images you have, and the domain you want to use. If you do not have a Framer account yet, we will guide you through creating one, and you stay the owner. Invite us as a collaborator. We never ask for passwords.

You pay Framer for your plan and any domain costs directly. Our price covers the design and build work.
